text: Re-scoped and MEASURED 2026-09-25: NOT a zoom-cull or camera/perf-mod bug. Root cause is vanilla body-hidden-when-swimming rendering: PawnRenderNodeWorker_Body.CanDrawNow() returns false when PawnRenderFlags.NoBody is set (set when Pawn.Swimming=CurJob.swimming); PawnRenderNodeWorker_Head never checks NoBody, so the head keeps drawing. Screenshot proof: Holmes (Human822690) at (112,12) renders as a floating head with no body above the beach line. get_cell_info confirms (112,12) terrain=RUT_ScaldMargin -- our own WaterShallowBase-derived custom terrain (TerminalBiomes/Defs/TerrainDefs/RUT_ScaldMargin.xml) -- so vanilla correctly reads him as standing in water and hides the body; this part is not a bug. Hicks vanishes on dry Sand nearby, consistent with a stale CurJob.swimming flag not clearing after leaving our water, combined with PawnRenderer's useCached path (Find.CameraDriver.ZoomRootSize>18f uses a cached humanlike atlas; <=18f always renders the live tree honoring whatever NoBody state is current) -- this explains the zoom-dependent flicker without any screen-rect culling bug. Ollopom/RM_Shulla vanishing but Dactillion/RM_Noohm not tracks the same mechanism via DrawNonHumanlikeSwimmingGraphic: only PawnKindDefs with swimmingGraphicData set get a swim sprite when Swimming; without one a submerged small animal falls into the same suppressed-body rendering.
